description: Which engines a launcher, stage or spacecraft uses, from relations a source states (engine part of vehicle, vehicle carries engine). Each engine comes with its stage or role (role, note), the quote and source, its makers and suppliers, and the material ids in it, so you can go on to get_product for the engine or products_using_material for its alloys. engine_known false means a source names the engine for this vehicle but the engine is not a product here yet (only its name is kept). Accepts an id, title or alias (F9, SLS).

vehicle.description: Vehicle product id, title or alias, for example ula-vulcan-centaur or Falcon 9

name: engines_for_vehicle
title: Engines used by a vehicle
